info.title: AgentFlow local API
info.description: Implemented P01–P05 operations, including native SSE, joined tracking and Activity snapshots, and the browser subscription/recovery owner. Producer CLI hooks and workflows remain planned. Metadata is inert; credentials never belong in URLs. Cookie mutations require exact Origin and same-origin Fetch Metadata. Reporter mutations permit originless requests or an exact allowed local Origin. JSON bodies are capped at 64 KiB and five seconds. Mutation budget is installation-wide 100 per second with burst 200.

get.description: Selected business history from one completed private snapshot. Omitted groups and cross-group references are intentionally incomplete; this is not a restorable backup. Missing completion means interrupted download. No continuation or resume.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Nonempty duplicate-free subset in canonical order. Unknown and repeated keys, cursor and unsupported groups are rejected before copying.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Task create only. Single return=minimal preference accepts case-insensitive name and surrounding/equal-sign spaces or tabs; the value minimal is case-sensitive. Unsupported, malformed, duplicate or conflicting forms return the full receipt. Compact data is a pure view of the original receipt, with original status/cursor/body generation and current generation header.

Vary.description: Full and minimal task creation representations vary on Prefer; existing Vary values remain.

Preference-Applied.description: Present only for the compact task creation representation.
